mapper.sql: id, appointment_code, patient_id, doctor_id, appointment_date, token_number, reporting_time, reason, status, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS appointmentId, a.token_number AS tokenNumber, a.reporting_time AS reportingTime, p.id AS patientId, u.full_name AS patientName, p.patient_code AS patientCode, TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, p.date_of_birth, CURDATE()) AS age, p.gender AS gender, CASE WHEN a.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 'COMPLETED' WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'IN_PROGRESS' ELSE 'BOOKED' END AS status FROM appointments a JOIN patients p ON p.id = a.patient_id JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id LEFT JOIN consultations c ON c.appointment_id = a.id AND c.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' WHERE a.doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND a.appointment_date = #{date} ORDER BY a.token_number
SELECT FROM appointments WHERE id = #{id} AND doctor_id = #{doctorId}
mapper.update: UPDATE appointments SET status = 'COMPLETED' WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS patientId, p.patient_code AS patientCode, u.full_name AS fullName, TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, p.date_of_birth, CURDATE()) AS age, p.gender AS gender, u.phone AS phone, p.address AS address FROM patients p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id WHERE p.id = #{patientId}
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM appointments WHERE patient_id = #{patientId} AND doctor_id = #{doctorId}
